card.name: Continuing education in REMS training text
card.fires_on: The word "education" after "continuing", and "ME" in "CME/CE", in opioid REMS text about accredited education programs for prescribers. It also fires weakly on a separator in a book listing.

modes.label: Continuing education
modes.description: The word "education" right after "continuing" when naming accredited CE providers.
modes.example: Complete a REMS-compliant education program offered by an accredited provider of continuing<< education>> (CE) or another education program that

modes.label: CME/CE abbreviation
modes.description: The "ME" in CME/CE when pointing to lists of accredited REMS courses.
modes.example: To obtain further information on the opioid analgesic REMS and for a list of accredited REMS C<<ME>>/CE, call 1-8

card.writes: It seems to suppress course-like next words such as courses and recordings, which is odd for a pole that is negative here.
card.plain: It marks the spot in opioid REMS text where continuing education or CME courses are named.
